description: Secret field-name phrases for the Chrome extension redaction layers (content.js, network_redact.js, extension_evidence.py, extension_network.py). A field name, id, aria-label, autocomplete value or JSON key is split into lowercase tokens (camelCase and PascalCase boundaries, then any run of non-alphanumeric characters) and is secret when a phrase appears in it as whole consecutive tokens. content.js and network_redact.js embed an identical copy of this list; tests/test_extension_secret_field_names.py fails when they differ. 'code' alone is deliberately absent from phrases: an identifier is secret when its whole token list is one of exact_names ('code', 'sig', 'sid', 'refresh'), so code and X-Sig are secret but productCode and refresh_interval are not. Bare 'session' and 'key' are absent too, so session_count and record_key stay clear.
